'''Calibration Modules''' were weapon components used on [[Quad laser cannon/Legends|quad laser cannons]] such as the [[AG-2G quad laser cannon/Legends|AG-2G]]. They were located on the side of the weapon, near the midpoint.<ref name="EGWT" />
